verdict.rationale: Docs state skills are plain SKILL.md files written into the repo as ordinary files, and are explicitly marketed as 'Works with any agent: Claude Code · Cursor · Codex · Copilot' (mattpocock-skills-docs-42, -24, -47), implying interoperability consistent with the open Agent Skills format rather than vendor lock-in. However, there is no explicit claim of conformance to the 'Agent Skills specification' by name, and no independent/hands-on verification that the folder structure is spec-compliant beyond the vendor's own docs. Missing for 10: explicit reference to the open Agent Skills spec, and independent third-party confirmation that the skill folders validate/parse in other tooling.
